meta.dataset: BSP property-transfer dataset - New Jersey Jersey Shore ring (Ocean, Monmouth, Atlantic, Burlington)
meta.method: Primary: NJ Division of Taxation SR1A statewide sales extract (https://www.nj.gov/treasury/taxation/lpt/statdata/YTDSR1A2026.zip, 663-byte fixed-width, layout https://www.nj.gov/treasury/taxation/pdf/lpt/SR1Afilelayout.pdf; also Sales2025.zip checked - it ends at deed dates 2025-06 so contributes nothing in window). Filtered COUNTY-CODE in 01 Atlantic, 03 Burlington, 13 Monmouth, 15 Ocean and DEED-DATE >= 2025-09-01 (<= file date 2026-08-12). sale_date = DEED-DATE; price = VERIFIED-SALES-PRICE; arms_length = U-N-TYPE (U=usable/true, N=non-usable/false) with SR-NU-CODE kept as nu_code; use_code_raw = PROPERTY-CLASS (+CLASS-4-TYPE); year_built/sqft from SR1A YEAR-BUILT/LIVING-SPACE (year_built backfilled from MOD-IV YR_CONSTR). Geocoding: built PAMS_PIN (muncode_block[.suffix]_lot[.suffix]) per sale and queried NJOGIS Parcels_Composite_NJ_WM FeatureServer/0 (https://services2.arcgis.com/XVOqAjTOJ5P6ngMu/arcgis/rest/services/Parcels_Composite_NJ_WM/FeatureServer/0/query) with where=PAMS_PIN IN (...) batches of 200 via POST, returnCentroid=true, outSR=4326 (385 requests, 76,870 candidate PINs incl. suffix-normalized and parent-lot fallbacks); condo units (qualifier Cxxxx) map to the parent lot polygon centroid. Muni names from groupBy PCL_MUN,MUN_NAME statistics on the same layer. ZIP: owner mailing ZIP5 of the matched parcel when owner ST_ADDRESS = PROP_LOC (owner-occupied), else the dominant (>=60%) owner-occupied ZIP5 of the same block from a paginated outStatistics query (where ST_ADDRESS=PROP_LOC, groupBy PCLBLOCK,ZIP5 per municipality). Rounded lat/lon to 5 decimals.

caveats: Source lag: the state SR1A YTD file (last modified 2026-08-12) is dense only through May 2026 (Ocean/Monmouth/Atlantic partially into June 2026; Burlington ends ~2026-05); roughly a 3-4 month lag vs today (2026-09-24). A handful of July/Aug 2026 deed dates exist.

Window limited to deed dates 2025-09-01 onward to respect the ~25 MB file cap; the source also has ~13,800 in-scope records for 2025-06-01..2025-08-31 (available in YTDSR1A2026/Sales2025) that were excluded.

buyer and seller are null for every record: grantor/grantee name, street and ZIP fields are blank (redacted) in the public SR1A extract; consequently builder_flag is null (cannot be derived from seller name). A proxy field new_construction = (class 2 and year_built >= sale year - 1) is provided but under-counts because assessor year-built often lags new builds.

arms_length is derived from the SR1A usability flag: true when U-N-TYPE=U (usable) OR the non-usable code is 07 (property substantially improved after the assessment date - typically new construction/renovation, a genuine market sale) or 27 (sale before a completed revaluation/reassessment - excluded from ratio studies only; affects most Monmouth Sep-Dec 2025 sales). All other NU codes -> false (e.g. 01 family, 04 transfer of convenience, 10/12 fiduciary/sheriff, 14 doubtful title/quit-claim, 25 and others). Many false rows carry nominal prices ($1-$100). Raw code is kept in nu_code (null = usable); see N.J.A.C. 18:12-1.1 for definitions. For market analysis filter arms_length=true and price>1000.

NJ property class mapping: 1->land, 2->residential, 3A (farm regular)->other, 3B (qualified farmland)->land, 4A->commercial, 4B->industrial, 4C (apartments)->residential, 15A-F (exempt)->other. No mixed-use class exists in NJ.

geo_precision=parcel_centroid for ~97.8% of rows; ~830 rows (new subdivisions/lots not yet in the MOD-IV parcel composite) have null lat/lon and geo_precision=none. Condo unit sales share the parent-lot centroid. zip is derived (owner-occupied mailing ZIP of the parcel or block) and is null for ~2,200 rows.
beds not available in SR1A or MOD-IV. sqft = SR1A LIVING-SPACE (assessor), may be 0/absent for land and some commercial.
Multi-lot deeds: price is the whole-deed consideration attached to the main lot; additional lots in the deed are not split out.

NJOGIS MOD-IV composite SALE_PRICE/DEED_DATE fields only hold the last sale per parcel and lag (latest deed dates ~2024-10..2024-12 in these counties), so they were not used for transactions, only for geometry, muni names, ZIP and year-built backfill.

Builder/new-construction proxy: nu_code=07 (improved after assessment date) plus new_construction=true flag the likely builder/new-home and heavy-renovation sales; builder_flag itself stays null because seller names are redacted.

QA 2026-09-24: Validated all 37,060 items (state/county present, sale_date valid ISO within 2015-01-01..2026-09-24, price null or >=1000, addr or lat/lon present, NJ lat/lon within [38.7,41.4]x[-75.6,-73.85], no duplicate ids). Removed 11,574 invalid items: 11,571 with a non-null price below $1000 (nominal/non-arms-length deed considerations such as $1 family transfers and sheriff sales, per NU codes not qualifying as arms-length) and 5 with neither an address nor lat/lon (unmatched parcels, geo_precision=none). No duplicate ids or out-of-bounds coordinates found. meta.coverage counts and item_count corrected to the 25,486 retained items (Ocean 9501, Monmouth 7539, Atlantic 3934, Burlington 4512). Spot-checked one retained record (id NJ-1506-20419-01543-1014_26.01-C0055, 5 PELHAM LN, Berkeley Twp, Ocean County) against the NJOGIS Parcels_Composite_NJ_WM FeatureServer (https://services2.arcgis.com/XVOqAjTOJ5P6ngMu/arcgis/rest/services/Parcels_Composite_NJ_WM/FeatureServer/0) by PAMS_PIN 1506_1014_26.01_C0055: address and block/lot matched exactly, and the parcel centroid (39.8807, -74.1684) matched the item's stored lat/lon (39.8803, -74.1681) within ~50m (condo unit sharing parent-lot centroid, as documented above); ZIP5 returned by the endpoint (08731) differs by one digit from the item's derived zip (08721), a minor discrepancy in the ZIP derivation step only, not affecting price/date/geo fields. File size after cleanup is well under the 30MB cap.
